motorcycle.name: Unbranded evergreen classic street motorcycle
motorcycle.authorship: Original procedural meshes and materials for this project; no downloaded model, branded badge, photograph or external texture is embedded.
motorcycle.referenceUse: Official component descriptions and published proportions informed the 1.45 m wheelbase, approximately 0.79 m saddle, spoke wheels, twin cradle, twin cylinders, round headlamp and swept handlebar. Generic interpretation, not a dimensional Triumph replica.
motorcycle.details: Physical spokes, discs, tire tread, engine fins, tubular frame, fork, sculpted tank, stitched saddle, controls and mirrors.
motorcycle.remaining: Cast markings, exact tire tread specification, cables and instrument lettering are simplified. No CAD or photogrammetry was used.

broom.name: Ash and reed enchanted commuter broom
broom.authorship: Original fictional prop with a curved ash handle, individually tapered reed bundle, brass bindings and subdued jade emissive details.
broom.motion: Low hover follows traversable ground; it does not implement free flight.

rider.source: Existing Pixiv and Sakurada avatars and their retargeted CC0 Seated animation; source licenses remain under public/assets/characters.
rider.method: Reversible skeleton overlay matches hips, wrists and ankles to actor-local contacts. Each mixer update starts from restored animation baselines. Torso lean adapts to arm length; neck and head compensate so the rider looks ahead.
rider.checks: Both avatars and both modes tested with actual mobile GLB node hierarchies: 240 stationary frames without accumulating rotation, head direction within 0.16 rad of the seated baseline, grip/foot contacts, correct left/right sides, and restoration to Idle.
rider.visualEvidence: Actual gameplay HUD and side-view captures are collected by scripts/check-world-commute.mjs in output/world-commute-20261025. Automated geometry checks do not establish final visual fidelity.
